steps.title: Configure Project Structure & Build Configuration
steps.description: Establish Gradle build setup and manifest declarations conforming to Android SDK 34 without external dependencies.

steps.title: Setup App Meta and Schemas
steps.description: Create app-meta, api_schema, and admin settings metadata for offline kirana operations.

steps.title: Define Design Resources and Styles
steps.description: Generate XML colors, strings, drawables, and material styles for grocery store POS interface.

steps.title: Implement SQLite Database Engine and Models
steps.description: Develop SQLiteOpenHelper and entity models for products, customers, sales, udhaar credit, purchases, and expenses.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard and Quick Navigation
steps.description: Build MainActivity dashboard displaying key performance indicators (sales, udhaar, low stock) with quick-action shortcuts.

steps.title: Build Product Catalog & Inventory Management
steps.description: Create ProductListActivity and AddEditProductActivity to manage stock, units, cost, and selling rates.

steps.title: Build Customer & Udhaar Ledger System
steps.description: Develop CustomerListActivity, AddEditCustomerActivity, and CustomerDetailActivity for managing khata credit and repayments.

steps.title: Build POS Billing and Cart Module
steps.description: Implement NewSaleActivity and SaleBillDetailActivity supporting item quantity adjustment, stock validation, and bill print summary.

steps.title: Implement Purchases and Expense Trackers
steps.description: Construct activities for supplier procurement stock updates and daily kirana overhead expenses.

steps.title: Implement Reports and Data Export Manager
steps.description: Build ReportsActivity and BackupManager utility for generating business analytics and offline CSV backup exports.

steps.title: Building Al Faris Kirana
steps.description: Assemble and verify Android APK build with full offline SQLite storage and POS capabilities.
